name: Sonar sketch
what: A sonar ping that draws the world: 900 rays march outward with the expanding front through any distance/density field and leave glowing points on the walls the moment the front reaches them; the points flash, then cool from teal to deep blue to black over 4 s. Targets in range come back as amber knots, and a hidden big body can be sketched beyond the walls in dim drifting points, faint even through rock. Time-budgeted (2 ms a frame), one THREE.Points ring buffer, fade in the shader.
use_when: the player navigates darkness, fog or an unseen space by echolocation, radar, scanner pulses or a reveal wave, and the level can be described by a distance or density function
good_for: Dark caves, deep sea, haunted houses, blind or bat characters, sci-fi scanner pulses: any game where seeing the space is a resource the player spends.
not_for: Lit, daytime scenes (the points are the reveal and vanish against a bright frame); levels with no field at all (you need at least a rough SDF of the walls); WebGPU renderers.
